visual_review.notes: Reviewed on H3 video. Idle v1, attack v1 and death v2 are clean. Ranged v2 aims, holds and lowers the blowpipe with no smoke; the one muzzle-flash frame (67) is dropped and contact moves to 66. Hit v2 flinches and recovers. Defend v2 crouches behind the cloak and ends on the held guard before she stands, skipping two top-cut frames. Cast v1 and v2 strobed and v4 shows a white streak from the blowpipe, so cast v3 is used: the opening hold jumps from frame 11 to 38 to skip a green tint. The walk keeps the published clip.
